name: documents
description: File documents into collections defined by your own rules: matching mail is filed automatically, anything else by API. Invoices, receipts, warranties, contracts — one engine.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 009_documents.sql, hot-loads the app).

Create a collection with matching rules: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/documents/collections -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "invoices-acme", "match_from": "billing@acme.com"}'
With the email package, matching mail files itself; without it, add documents manually (optionally referencing files stored by the storage package).
